name: NovaCell Peptides
shipsTo: 25 EU countries and the United Arab Emirates (by inquiry); exact EU list not confirmed
coaAccess: Public product-page batch tables link to shop-hosted PDFs; the PDFs link to original reports on the Liquilabs domain.
freeShippingThreshold: From €115 per the shipping policy; shop and FAQ say over €115, and the UAE is handled separately.
dispatchInfo: The shop says tracking is sent on the day payment arrives (Mon–Sat by 14:00 CET); DPD/DHL are named and EU delivery is estimated at 2–6 business days.

subscore_reasons.labVerification: All 4 sampled reports were read on Liquilabs and matched the listed product, client and batch; LYO-0585 had a different publication date and page count from its shop copy.
subscore_reasons.fillAccuracy: The 4 sampled reports measured 97.9%–122.0% of label; BPC-157 and TB-500 were 119.3% and 122.0%, respectively.
subscore_reasons.panelDepth: Read reports show purity, assay, FTIR, retention-time and mass-spectrometry identity, plus a separate endotoxin report; no sterility or heavy-metal results were confirmed in the sample.
subscore_reasons.entityTransparency: The Estonian Business Register confirms the seller name, registration code, Tallinn address and VAT ID; the shop separately states dispatch from Poland.
subscore_reasons.dispatchReliability: The shop names carriers, a tracking cut-off and EU transit estimates, but the public pages differ on destination scope and the exact free-shipping boundary.
subscore_reasons.valuePerMg: At the displayed single-vial sale prices, retatrutide and BPC-157 were above the matching EUR medians in the existing audit, while TB-500 was slightly below.

strengths: All 4 sampled COAs were read on the original Liquilabs domain and matched the shop's named products and batch codes.
The Estonian register independently confirms the seller details; the shop separately identifies Poland as the dispatch country.
weaknesses: The BPC-157 and TB-500 reports measured 11.93 mg and 12.20 mg against 10 mg labels.
The TB-500 shop catalogue calls it a fragment, but the product specifications and laboratory report identify thymosin beta-4.
The shop and lab copies of LYO-0585 differ in publication date and page count, although the sample, batch and reported assay and purity agree.
verdict: NovaCell publishes lot-linked reports that could be read on Liquilabs. The sampled BPC-157 and TB-500 reports were above label, and the TB-500 catalogue wording conflicts with the laboratory identification.
summary: NovaCell Peptides is a research-reagent shop operated by NCBL Sciences OÜ in Estonia, with dispatch from Poland according to the shop. Four sampled reports were read on Liquilabs.
notes: The exact EU destination list and fulfilment address were not confirmed. The terms say 25 EU countries plus the UAE; the shipping page says 25 in one section and all EU member states in another. Purity reported as a lower bound is not entered as an exact percentage. Prices are single-vial snapshots, excluding quantity discounts. The batch match is to the public shop listings, not to a vial purchased for this audit.
